records.title: Mining and utilisation of Nuclear Energy Minerals in Rajasthan
details: a to b: Action is in hand to obtain all statutory clearances for commencing the mining operations.

records.title: Linking of Railway Line from Devgarh Madariya to Bilara.
details:
a to b): Therefore, in order to provide Broad Gauge connectivity, a
survey of Devgarh Madariya-Phulad- Marwar (72 Km) new line has been
sanctioned for preparation of DPR. Jaitaran is served presently by Bilara station about 30 Km away. However, to provide direct connectivity to Jaitaran, survey of Ras-Jaitaran-Bilara new line (53 Km) has been sanctioned for preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR).
